gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 concerns the false fractional product rule and the convective energy estimate. It does not identify the distinct spectral-error operation of bounding the derivative of the modified projection, nor the alpha=1, r=2 endpoint failure of the claimed uniform N^{-r} estimate.

ISSUE-002 diagnoses failure of global continuation for the PDE due to a nonuniform local lifespan. It does not address the missing N-uniform bounds on transformed vector-field derivatives, semidiscrete trajectories, or RK4 stage remainders needed for a uniform fifth-order one-step defect.

ISSUE-002 concerns global PDE existence and continuation, whereas the gold issue concerns nonlinear error propagation between semidiscrete flows and the missing N- and time-step-independent stability estimate required to convert local consistency into global fourth-order temporal convergence.
